notes.title: Version 2.1.1 Now Available
notes.notes:
- Bug fix for getting stuck in Tillinghast's shop in Turn of a Page scenario.
- Bug fix for artifacts not spawning correctly in Turn of a Page scenario.
- Minor fixes for Altered Fates, Astral Alchemy, and Behind Closed Doors.

notes.title: Version 2.0.3 Now Available
notes.notes:
- Fix bug where tokens would not have a highlight when being placed
- Various other bug fixes
This update is currently only available for Windows. 2.0.3 update for OSX will be coming soon.

notes.title: Version 2.0.2 Now Available
notes.notes: - Fixed bug where Message Log wouldn't display messages properly

notes.title: v2.0.1 Update - Adding AsmoConnect!
notes.notes:
- (New Feature) AsmoConnect - Sign up or log in to enable cross platform cloud saving. DLC purchases will also be linked to your AsmoConnect account and can be accessed on any device.
- Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.9.2 Now Available
notes.notes:
We have updated our game engine to provide better support for newer devices.
With this upgrade, the Graphics and Resolution settings will now be available in the in-game options menu.
Some users may need to re-enable their physical game expansions in the in-app Collection menu

notes.title: Version 1.8.8 Now Available
notes.notes: Minor bug fix for Lost Temple of Yig scenario

notes.title: Version 1.8.7 Now Available
notes.notes:
- Thai language now available! 
- Various bug fixes and small features
